name: Find files
description: Find files in the workspace by name. A command plugin: this manifest is the whole plugin, with no script.

actions.title: Find files
actions.description: List the files under a folder whose name matches a pattern, for example *.md. Skips .git. Changes nothing.

name.description: File name pattern; * matches any text. No slash, and no leading dash.

folder.description: Folder inside the workspace, relative to its root. No leading slash or dash, and no .. segment.
